body.name: \(\widehat\theta_{\mathrm{MK}}^{\mathrm{ind}}\)
body.construction: Fit untreated individual-observation fixed-effects PPML by maximizing \(\sum_{g\in C}\sum_{i=1}^{n_g}\sum_{t<g}[Y_{git}(\alpha_{gi}+\lambda_t)-\exp(\alpha_{gi}+\lambda_t)]\) under \(\lambda_1=0\); predict \(\widehat\mu^{\mathrm{MK}}_{git}=\exp(\widehat\alpha^{\mathrm{MK}}_{gi}+\widehat\lambda^{\mathrm{MK}}_t)\) for treated observations and form \(\widehat\theta_{\mathrm{MK}}^{\mathrm{ind}}=\frac{\sum_{(g,t)\in D}\sum_iY_{git}}{\sum_{(g,t)\in D}\sum_i\widehat\mu^{\mathrm{MK}}_{git}}-1\)
inputs: equal observation weights and no covariates or offsets
